## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), e.g. `feat(retrievals): add Nordpool data source`.
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/open-energy-transition/demandcast/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests cover the changes.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, if needed.
- [ ] If AI tools were used, the description says which ones and for what.
